content:
Trump Immigration Policy 2026 Green Card Freeze, Travel Ban & New Public Charge Rules Explained

Major U.S. immigration changes have arrived in 2026 under Donald Trump’s administration, and they are already affecting thousands of green card applicants worldwide. If you are currently waiting for a green card, planning to apply, or already a U.S. permanent resident, this update is extremely important.

In this video, we break down the latest immigration policy changes that could impact your green card process, visa application, and even existing permanent resident status. Several new policies have been introduced, including stricter Public Charge rules, expanded travel bans, and increased scrutiny of visa applicants’ social media accounts.

One of the biggest developments is the pause in immigrant visa processing for applicants from 75 countries. While U.S. embassies are still accepting applications and conducting interviews, many cases are currently being placed on hold after the interview stage. This means applicants may experience delays without a clear timeline for resolution.
title: Trump Immigration Policy 2026 Green Card Freeze, Travel Ban & New Public Charge Rules Explained

MAGA and immigration - In the shadow of Trump's border | DW Documentary

For centuries, the United States was considered a nation of immigrants. President Trump has changed that with a brutal crackdown on immigration. But with opposition growing, arguments about how to define American identity are on the rise, once more.

Since 2025, the US government has been taking a tougher stance on immigration. The US Immigration and Custom’s Enforcement, or ICE, is raiding homes, businesses, and previously protected areas, like churches, schools and hospitals. It’s one of the major flashpoints in US politics right now. But criticism of Trump’s immigration policies is growing. What does the future hold?

The effects of US immigration policy shifts are most visible along the southern border.
